verdict.rationale: CockroachDB docs show clear local, no-cloud-account paths (cockroach demo in-memory cluster, single-node cluster for dev/testing, brew install) supporting offline dev/CI use (cockroachdb-docs-1, cockroachdb-docs-2, cockroachdb-docs-21). However, community evidence directly contradicts the 'keyless' claim: a user reports 'even free users need an annual license key' (cockroachdb-comm-4), undermining the no-account/no-license premise. missing for 10: first-party confirmation that no license/account is needed for local/CI runs, and clarity on enterprise-feature gating that may require keys even locally.
